assertions: The official GET /api/v1/crates/<crate>/<version> endpoint returns serde 1.0.228 without authentication.
The exact crate identity, SHA-256 checksum, artifact size, license expression, minimum Rust version, edition, publication time, project links and library/binary shape match the reviewed fixture.

The Connector sends one request through a minimum one-second in-process gate with a contactable application User-Agent, accepts no alternate API base, redirect, range/latest alias or response larger than 1 MiB.

The normalized output excludes download counts, publisher identity, audit users, avatars, raw features, dependencies, raw response, token and cookie data; it does not download or execute the crate artifact.
